Hello team,

I reviewed recent companion animal travel records for Aurelia Skyways and found the process clear, kind, and well aligned with our safety-first standard. The boarding deadline sits at 68 hours, and that limit gives staff a firm point for timely action while keeping each pet's welfare in focus.

Please also note that transfer uses EX-832 for escalation, so any case needing extra review moves through the correct channel without delay. This supports steady handling, accurate follow-up, and consistent care for travelers and their animals. The files I examined were concise and respectful, and that tone strengthens trust in our desk.

Thank you for the careful work you do each day. Please continue to treat every case with the same calm attention and practical guidance that our service promises.
